channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap over next 20 years
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall over the next 20 years, a gap that could shape how residents get around for decades. The Martin County Metropolitan Planning Organization estimates the county will need approximately $2.8 billion for transportation improvements

item.title: Fort Pierce Planning Board reviews Causeway Cove proposal with five high-rise buildings up to 17 stories
item.description: Fort Pierce neighbors packed a planning board meeting Monday to review a development proposal for Causeway Cove that includes a 17-story building standing 192 feet tall, more than four times the city's height limit.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap with nine road widening projects unfunded
item.description: Martin County estimates it will need approximately $2.8 billion for transportation improvements over the next 20 years but only $701 million is currently available, leaving a $2.1 billion shortfall.

item.title: Port St. Lucie City Council rezones lot to commercial despite homeowner opposition
item.description: A Port St. Lucie couple fought for months against rezoning the lot behind their home from residential to commercial, but the city council voted unanimously to approve the change in what officials called a quasi-judicial hearing.

item.title: Hobe Sound couple seeks community support as husband battles head and neck cancer
item.description: Dave and Faren Motz of Hobe Sound are asking for community support as they navigate a cancer diagnosis that has cost them nearly $20,000 out of pocket after nearly seven weeks of daily radiation treatments.

item.title: Czech player Linda Noskova wins Wimbledon women's title after five blown match points
item.description: Linda Noskova overcame Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 in an all-Czech Wimbledon final on Saturday. The 21-year-old wasted five match points in the second set before recovering for her first Grand Slam trophy.

item.title: England and Argentina reach World Cup semifinals, face off Tuesday
item.description: England and Argentina advanced to the World Cup semifinals after victories over Norway and Switzerland. The match will be held Tuesday as part of the final four.

item.title: Jannik Sinner beats Alexander Zverev to win second straight Wimbledon title
item.description: Top-ranked Jannik Sinner beat Alexander Zverev 6-7 (7), 7-6 (2), 6-3, 6-4 Sunday for his second consecutive title at the All England Club. item.description: Florida Democrats point to more than 30 local and special-election wins as evidence they can break Republican supermajorities in the state Legislature, outlining a comeback strategy focused on affordability during a Monday briefing. item.title: Rising insurance costs become key election issue for 65% of Florida voters in new study
item.description: A new study from online insurance marketplace Insurify found 65% of Florida respondents said rising insurance costs would make them more likely to vote in the 2026 midterms.

item.title: Hobe Sound couple seeks support as Dave Motz battles head and neck cancer
item.description: Dave and Faren Motz moved to Hobe Sound and purchased a property, but just months after settling in, Dave was diagnosed with head and neck cancer.

item.title: Fire engulfs Ford F-250 pickup on Florida's Turnpike in St. Lucie County
item.description: St. Lucie County Fire District crews responded to a fully involved vehicle fire Monday morning on Florida's Turnpike Northbound near Mile Marker 175.

item.title: Port St. Lucie couple fights city council rezoning of lot behind their home from residential to commercial
item.description: Margaret and Joseph Mucciolo say they feel unheard after the Port St. Lucie City Council unanimously voted to rezone the lot behind their home from residential to commercial.

item.description:

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb to panoramic views
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, offers visitors a 105-step climb to panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.
